findings.title: Exposed Anthropic API Key in .env file
findings.description: An Anthropic API key is stored in plain text in llm-mesh/.env. While .env is gitignored, this key should be rotated immediately as it may have been exposed in local development or backups.
findings.remediation:
1. Immediately rotate the Anthropic API key at console.anthropic.com
2. Use environment variable injection from a secrets manager
3. Remove the actual key from .env and use placeholder

findings.title: d3-color ReDoS vulnerability
findings.description: Package d3-color in eui-dashboard is vulnerable to Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS). This can cause performance degradation or denial of service.
findings.remediation: Update d3-color to version 3.1.0 or higher

findings.title: d3-interpolate vulnerability (via d3-color)
findings.description: Package d3-interpolate is affected by the d3-color ReDoS vulnerability through its dependency chain.
findings.remediation: Update @elastic/charts to latest version which includes fixed dependencies

findings.title: esbuild development server vulnerability
findings.description: esbuild versions <=0.24.2 have a vulnerability that allows any website to send requests to the development server and read responses. This affects vitest and vite-node dependencies.
findings.remediation: Update vitest to version 4.0.13 or higher

findings.title: PrismJS DOM Clobbering vulnerability
findings.description: prismjs version <1.30.0 is vulnerable to DOM Clobbering which can lead to XSS attacks.
findings.remediation: Update @elastic/eui to version 32.3.0 or downgrade to avoid affected versions

findings.title: @elastic/eui indirect vulnerability via refractor
findings.description: @elastic/eui is indirectly affected by the PrismJS vulnerability through the refractor dependency.
findings.remediation: Update @elastic/eui to latest version or downgrade to 32.3.0

findings.title: vite development server vulnerability
findings.description: vite versions 0.11.0 - 6.1.6 are affected by the esbuild vulnerability through their dependency chain.
findings.remediation: Update vitest to version 4.0.13 which includes updated vite

findings.title: vitest development vulnerability
findings.description: vitest version is in the vulnerable range for esbuild/vite issues.
findings.remediation: Update vitest to version 4.0.13 or higher

findings.title: vite-node indirect vulnerability
findings.description: vite-node is affected through its vite dependency.
findings.remediation: Update vitest to latest which includes updated vite-node

findings.title: llm-mesh middleware missing package-lock.json
findings.description: The llm-mesh/gateway/middleware project has a package.json but no package-lock.json, preventing proper dependency auditing and potentially causing inconsistent installations.
findings.remediation: Run 'npm install' in the directory to generate package-lock.json, or remove if not in active use

findings.title: API key placeholder in example documentation
findings.description: DEPLOYMENT.md contains example API keys in documentation that could be confused with real credentials.
findings.remediation: Use clearly fake example keys like 'sk-ant-example-xxx' instead of realistic-looking keys
